comparison: Compared under protocol seed 0, deterministic_orthogonal initialization, and discriminator_stability revision 9 against the BCAP DualNorm leader (recipe-prior-refactor-bcap-pure-v1, 9/21 Tier 2 passes) and the 15-candidate bcap-prior-search matrix, bispf-v1 is the first single global recipe in the repository to simultaneously pass mode_hold and five_word_joint_hold (25/25).
conclusion: Born-Infeld Sinkhorn Particle Flow (BISPF, bispf-v1) passes 6/6 required Tier 1 tasks plus clockfree_audit_measurement_v1 (7/7 total, 22/22 across all 6 views) and 10/21 required Tier 2 tasks (55/116 across all 6 views, 77/152 total across views vs. 71/152 for the BCAP DualNorm leader). BISPF repairs mode_hold (FAIL -> PASS: modes=8, effective_modes=7.47686, cover=1.0, hq=0.99951) while preserving 25/25 mandatory checks on five_word_joint_hold and all 8 other BCAP leader Tier 2 passes (0 regressions), and improves 100-mode grid100 precision from 0.25801 to 0.37015 (+43.5% relative) and staggered100 precision from 0.29954 to 0.34184 (+14.1% relative). Tier 3 remains blocked by the 11 remaining Tier 2 failures.

decision_outcomes.reuse_note: Compatible original receipts; overlapping readouts are not independent runs or additive costs

hypothesis: Born-Infeld Sinkhorn Particle Flow (critic_formulation=bispf, prior_regularizer=sbnp, prior_reg=0.01) passes all 6 Tier 1 gates, repairs mode_hold in Tier 2 while preserving all 9 BCAP leader Tier 2 passes (including five_word_joint_hold), and passes both Tier 3 endurance gates (ring_hold and ring_extension) under constant learning rates.
next_action: Retain bispf-v1 as the selected current measurement for the BISPF family (16/29 on discriminator_stability, 77/152 across views). Target the remaining 11 Tier 2 bottlenecks (gaussian1d_stability post-shift transport, non-uniform mass/anisotropic 2D mixtures, 4-mode conv image symmetry breaking, and 100-mode cluster tightness) in a bounded follow-up study before spending on Tier 3.

study.competing_explanation: If Sinkhorn transport chords and degree-of-freedom-aware SBNP regularization only shifted the prior tether trade-off without stabilizing mode capture, either mode_hold would fail its terminal passing suffix (>= 5) or five_word_joint_hold / ring_hold would fail under constant learning rates.
